Percent style encodes spaces and parens in link URLs

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{url_escape_style: "percent"}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"/file (1).pdf\">file</a>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result)
```
